evidence.text: The exact file page labels 期-seal.svg as a vector depicting 期 in Shuowen seal-script style, says it is based on the S04924 image in Chinese Etymology, and dates the current vector file to 3 January 2015. Its file-history comment names components 其 and 月, and its license section states public-domain status. These page labels document the redraw’s identity and provenance; they do not independently establish the visible component analysis or a historical stage.
evidence.title: File:期-seal.svg

evidence.field: GSR 0952a and 0952k; MC and OC columns
evidence.text: The table records 其 qí as MC gi, OC *gə (modal particle and third-person possessive entries), and 期 qī as MC gi, OC *[g](r)ə (‘period of time’). Thus the table supports a same-system comparison: the Middle Chinese transcriptions match, and the Old Chinese forms are similar but not identical. This phonological compatibility does not by itself establish the phonetic role in the compound graph.

gaps: The image’s actual contours were not visually inspected in this research pass. Alt text should therefore describe only the visible shapes established by the attached image itself, not identify them as 其 and 月; selection wording should identify it as a seal-script-style redraw labeled 期.
The official Unihan character-specific records for 其 and 期 were not opened during this pass. The exact local rows give qí and qī, but they are not externally verified here.
Baxter–Sagart’s matching Middle Chinese forms and similar, distinct Old Chinese reconstructions are compatible with a sound relationship; this table alone does not prove 其’s phonetic function in 期.
